name: forced-ledger-display
title: Always show a status ledger after mutating commands, with visible render failures
description: Story-scoped mutating commands only append a Milestone Ledger table when a milestone ledger already exists, and swallow render failures to stderr. A story that has a checklist but no milestone ledger shows no status view after checklist_update / story_advance / etc. This story makes every command in MILESTONE_STATUS_APPEND_COMMANDS always emit a status block: it falls back to a checklist-derived ledger when no milestone ledger exists, and surfaces render failures on stdout instead of hiding them. The prior no-table behavior was a deliberate anti-fabrication choice, so the fallback uses a distinct header and does not impersonate a milestone table.
